architectureDecisions: D1: In commandSmoke compute permission=options.permission??PermissionProfile.WORKSPACE_EDIT and validate against Object.values(PermissionProfile) before resolving/spawning tools or creating scratch. Forward model:options.model??null and permissionProfile:permission to the existing runSupervisedTask call.

D2: With trace-dir construct createSupervisedObservation using resolved tool, taskId smoke-${toolId}, arm options.arm??SMOKE and createRunTraceWriter({dir}). Forward invocationObserver/eventSinks/tracer and await finalize(result) before existing print/return branches. Without trace-dir create no observation/writer. Existing parsed arm is a trace label modifier; reject arm without trace-dir before effects.

D3: Leave runSupervisedTask defaults and smoke return branches intact: maxAttempts2, default timeout600000 with existing timeout override, WORKSPACE_EDIT/no model/no traces when omitted. Missing tool returns SKIPPED NOT_INSTALLED; failed-before-edit returns SKIPPED TOOL_FAILED_BEFORE_EDIT. Current exit codes stay unchanged.

D4: Add only smoke USAGE flags model/permission/trace-dir and optional arm label. Reuse existing report/readTraces/verifyTraceFile with no changes. Traces encode model/sandbox in argvRedacted, not invented top-level model/permission fields; compare against separately captured fake-agent argv.

D5: Fixtures invoke actual BIN smoke with delivered FIX_FIRST fake-agent through a capture launcher. Invalid-input cases prove zero capture-marker writes; omission proves unchanged argv and no writer. Trace control proves every recorded invocation has one valid trace and matching tool/task/arm, actual report exits0, copied corrupted trace report exits1.

D6: Existing finally removes only smoke scratch. Caller trace dir remains after successful, SKIPPED or failed result finalization. Future tests compare scratch disappearance against trace retention, not absence of a handle. Update only declared Living docs; no smoke recovery or QA authority changes.
implementationSlices: S1 — bin/exharness-agent.mjs: edit only commandSmoke and smoke help/header text. Implement D1-D4 using delivered exports: preflight permission/arm, forward model and permission, conditional observation construction/forwarding, await finalize before existing SKIPPED/result branches. Leave current task, retries, timeout, env mapping and finally scratch disposal unchanged. No run/report/supervisor/observation edits.

S2 — smoke-cli-options.test.js: actual BIN fixtures P1 argv forwarding, P2 valid trace/report/corrupt-copy/arm controls, literal N1 invalid-input and N2 omitted-default titles, P3 SKIPPED controls and P4 cleanup. Every dynamic test invokes commandSmoke through BIN; trace schema assertions use argvRedacted. Call-site assertion supplements unexposed maxAttempts/timeout values; it does not replace real child dispatch checks.

S3 — declared agent-tools Living state/observation: document smoke model/permission/trace-dir, SMOKE default label, optional arm modifier, omitted defaults and SKIPPED/cleanup compatibility. Run focused, agent-tools-regression, docs and repository checks with candidate-bound logs after exact READY. Research publishes only exact independent readiness, without product edits or fabricated verification.
